name: Account Switcher
description: Cross-platform on-the-fly account switcher for Orca managed agents, agy CLI, and built-in Google OAuth vault with live quotas.

commands.title: Account Switcher: Switch to Best Gemini Account

settings.title: Auto-refresh interval (seconds)
settings.description: Background refresh interval in seconds. 0 (recommended) disables background polling (manual Refresh / Best only); any non-zero value enforces a 600s minimum.

settings.title: Status bar click action
settings.description: What clicking the Account Switcher status bar item does.
enumLabels: Switch to best Gemini quota account

settings.title: Enable AGY / Google Vault
settings.description: Manage built-in Google OAuth vault and ~/.antigravity_tools/accounts (if present) for on-the-fly agy CLI + Orca switching.

settings.title: Auto-switch Antigravity on low quota
settings.description: Automatically switch to the highest-quota AGY account when active effective Gemini quota drops below the threshold.

settings.title: Low quota threshold (%)
settings.description: Effective Gemini remaining % below which auto-switch triggers.

settings.title: Custom Google OAuth Client ID (optional)
settings.description: Optional override when neither Orca acp_token.json nor agy CLI is initialized yet.

settings.title: Custom Google OAuth Client Secret (optional)
settings.description: Optional override paired with Custom Google OAuth Client ID.

settings.title: Check for plugin updates
settings.description: Periodically check GitHub for newer versions of Account Switcher (every 6 hours, cached locally).
